mapper.update: UPDATE applications SET duration = ( SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(finish_time) - MIN(launch_time), 0) AS BIGINT) FROM tasks WHERE app_id = #{appId} ), performance_score = ( SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(j.performance_score * j.duration) / NULLIF(SUM(j.duration), 0), 100) AS INTEGER) FROM jobs j WHERE j.app_id = #{appId} AND j.duration > 0 ) WHERE app_id = #{appId}
